# Appropriation Ordinance No. 02, Series of 1997

**Appropriation Ordinance No. 02**

## Summary

An appropriation ordinance adopting the Closing Special Budget of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] for the fiscal year. From the total savings amounting to Two Million, Fifty-Four Thousand, Nine Hundred Eighty-Six Pesos and Seventy-Two Centavos (P 2,054,986.72), the amount of One Hundred Forty-One Thousand, Five Hundred Eighty-Nine Pesos and Seventy-Five Centavos (P 141,589.75) is hereby appropriated to cover the overdraft in appropriation. The ordinance takes effect immediately upon approval.

**Total savings:** P 2,054,986.72
**Amount appropriated to cover overdraft:** P 141,589.75

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** From the total savings amounting to P 2,054,986.72, the amount of P 141,589.75 is hereby appropriated to cover the overdraft in appropriation.
- **Section 2.** This ordinance shall take effect immediately.
